instructions.name: borrow_principal
docs: Borrow principal against a locked loan.

instructions.name: claim_vault_rewards
docs: Claim accrued rewards on staked user-vault LP positions.

instructions.name: close_loan
docs: Close an existing Loopscale loan PDA.

instructions.name: create_loan
docs: Create a new Loopscale loan PDA owned by the GLAM vault.

instructions.name: deposit_collateral
docs: Deposit collateral into a Loopscale loan.

instructions.name: deposit_user_vault
docs: Deposit principal into a Loopscale user vault and mint LP tokens to the GLAM vault.

instructions.name: lock_loan
docs: Lock a loan to commit borrowed principal and collateral.

instructions.name: refinance_ledger
docs: Refinance a loan ledger from one strategy to another.

instructions.name: repay_principal
docs: Repay principal on a Loopscale loan.

instructions.name: set_loopscale_policy
docs: Set the `LoopscalePolicy` (deposit, borrow, and market allowlists) on the GLAM state.

instructions.name: stake_user_vault_lp
docs: Stake user-vault LP tokens to earn rewards.

instructions.name: update_weight_matrix
docs: Update the collateral weight matrix on a loan.

instructions.name: withdraw_collateral
docs: Withdraw collateral from a Loopscale loan.

instructions.name: withdraw_user_vault
docs: Withdraw principal from a Loopscale user vault by redeeming LP tokens.

types.name: IntegrationAcl
docs: An integration program can have multiple protocols supported.
Enabled protocols are stored in a bitmask, and each protocol can have its own policy.

types.name: IntegrationPermissions
docs: Stores delegate permissions for an integration program.

types.name: OracleConfigs
docs: Vault-specific oracle configs. If available, these configs are preferred over the global config.

types.name: ProtocolPermissions
docs: Represents a delegate's permissions for a specific protocol

types.name: ProtocolPolicy
docs: Stores policy data for an integrated protocol.
